title: Headless TTW Who Dares Wins (DLC03BS3): from Shock Value's end through Adams Air Force Base and the orbital strike aimed at the Enclave's mobile base crawler to Elder Lyons' thanks (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Joins Shock Value's end (the DLC03BS2 chain plays it). So that Broken Steel's world is set up as in play, the chain wakes the player in the Citadel (DLC03BS1 0, as the ending's script does), then sets the earlier quests' last stages as their chains end them: DLC03BS1 200 (starts Shock Value) and DLC03BS2 200 [observed], which starts Who Dares Wins (DLC03BS3) with objective 10.
Travel stand-in: to the Presidential Metro (DLC03PresMetro01); being in it [observed] (the quest's script) completes objective 10 and shows 20.

actions.label: milestone: objective 20, Adams Air Force Base

actions.text: Travel stand-in: through the metro to Adams Air Force Base; arriving at DLC03AFBArrivalMarker [observed] shows objective 30.

actions.label: milestone: objective 30, the mobile base crawler

actions.text: Stand-in for the fight across the base and the way into the Mobile Base Crawler (the breach; the AI): the player goes into the crawler (DLC03EnclaveBase01).

The fire control terminal (the placed DLC03FireControlTerminal): Fire Payload, Preset Target 05: Adams AFB Platform, Fire Payload, Confirm [observed] aims the orbital strike at the crawler itself (BS3StrikeTarget 1), not at the Citadel.

With the platform destroyed (DLC03PlatformBoom 1), the quest's script [observed] sends Lyons, Rothchild, Tristan and Sarah to their end-game markers. Travel stand-in: the player goes to Elder Lyons there; his greeting sets stage 200.

actions.label: lyons: when I first met you (stage 200)
